project_type: Python FastAPI backend - Autonomous AI Company Operating System
verification_instructions: Run pytest with python3.12, all 2335+ tests must pass. Use ruff for lint.
environment_constraints: Python 3.9 is default but python3.12 is available at /usr/bin/python3.12. Must use python3.12 explicitly. OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No running Redis or Docker daemon available for live integration tests - use mocks.
contribution_requirements: Type hints, docstrings, ruff compliant, 100 char line length, Python 3.12 syntax. All new functionality needs tests. Backward compatible - existing behavior unchanged when new backends not configured.
key_patterns: Pydantic models for data, Protocol classes for interfaces, async/await throughout, existing Redis pattern in redis_rate_limiter.py uses redis.asyncio, existing circuit breaker in governance/circuit_breaker_advanced.py, file persistence uses atomic write (tempfile + os.replace pattern), APIRouter pattern for endpoints
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main package; src/nexus/api/routes/ - FastAPI routers; src/nexus/governance/ - circuit breakers, rate limiters, controls; src/nexus/communication/ - hive manager, messaging; src/nexus/evolution/ - sandbox, proposals; src/nexus/memory/ - layered memory, extraction; src/nexus/orchestration/ - planner, critic; tests/ - all test files flat
